title: Vietnam’s HCM City sets up free trade zone in Cai Mep Ha port  area
summary:
Vietnam’s Ho Chi Minh City has set up the country’s first pilot free trade zone in the Cai Mep Hạ port area. 
The HCM City Export Processing and Industrial Zones Authority will oversee it. 
The project will integrate container terminals, the planned Cai Mep Hạ container port, an inland waterway port, the nearest railway station, industrial parks, logistics centres and industrial-urban-service complexes.

title: Textile industry cuts waste with lean manufacturing in 2026
summary:
Lean manufacturing is becoming a core operating strategy for textile and garment factories under margin, lead-time and sustainability pressure.
A 2026 garment study linked structured lean rollouts to nearly 18 per cent higher output and lead-time cuts of up to 80 per cent.

title: India halves PLI thresholds to boost mid-tier MMF investment
summary:

Exporters and sourcing teams will watch project completion, incentives and utilisation through FY2026-27 and FY2027-28.

title: Bangladesh's tariff edge faces a reality check at home
summary:

title: New Zealand's Oritain enrols Kyungbang as first spinner member

summary:
Cambodia's economy grew 5.3 per cent in 2025, with growth projected to moderate to 4.2 per cent in 2026 as energy costs and border disruptions weigh on activity, according to the AMRO.

summary:

Vietnam bucked the trend, gaining share and nearly catching Bangladesh as the second-largest supplier.
Canada’s clothing exports also fell 2.5 per cent as US shipments plunged 17.7 per cent, while exports to China surged nearly 180 per cent.

summary:
Nepal is seeking to revive its readymade garment and textile base by removing administrative bottlenecks and planning a dedicated Textile Council.

The government is also assessing Hetauda Textile Industry's reopening to serve security forces and later public and civilian markets.

title: US’ 10% duty under Section 301; India looking quota for T&A under BTA
summary:

The issue is part of ongoing India-US BTA talks, while the US quota mechanism is yet to be operationalised.

title: China’s $1 bn apparel export loss exposes margin squeeze
summary:

Knitwear remained resilient as exports shifted towards the US, Russia and Brazil.
Despite higher shipment volumes, apparel manufacturers faced severe pressure, with January–May profit margins at just 2.61 per cent.

title: Jordan’s textile-RMG exports to US to be exempt from customs duties
summary:
Jordan’s textile-garment exports to the US will be exempt from customs duties under the Reciprocal Trade Agreement signed in Washington, the former’s Minister of Industry, Trade and Supply Yarub Qudah said. 
The latter will also reduce reciprocal tariffs on other Jordanian exports to 10 per cent under the deal. 
Jordan will continue to grant duty-free access to US exports under the 2001 bilateral FTA.
